question:
You will be shown several images captured during a robotic manipulation task.
Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.


Image 1 (ego_left): This camera angle provides the robot's left arm perspective of the task.


Image 2 (fix_center): This image represents the central camera's perspective of the manipulation scene.


Image 3 (ego_right): This image was captured from a wrist-mounted camera on the robot's right arm.


The presented images show the same robotic manipulation task from different viewpoints.
However, one image was recorded at a different time, causing temporal inconsistency.
Analyze visual elements like lighting patterns, object placements, robot movements, and environmental details.
Which image number contains the temporally mismatched frame?
